scope_guards: Grade II listed status is a statutory heritage designation and not residential planning permission.
The official list's Mid C19 wording and the local heritage narrative's 1870 context are preserved as source-specific descriptions rather than silently reconciled.
The Planning Data point is not a complete legal, title or listed-curtilage polygon.
A statutory address does not quantify flats, homes or development capacity.
Heritage protection does not prove current use, occupancy, ownership or implementation.
No historical flat or company address is converted into dwelling capacity.
No exact current residential application or HMLR relation is claimed.
No score or promotion is written without a current scheme, permission, exact geometry, title relation and executed overlays.
